correctness.rationale: Three cyclic rotations yield a winner iff at least two rotations coincide, giving A_n=(3n-2)/n². With exactly one uniform ballot and two rotations, only leaders of two opposing blocks can win; mutually exclusive probabilities are 1/(j+1) and 1/(n-j+1), summing to B_n=(2H_n-1)/n. Two impartial ballots and one fixed ranking have same winner chance Q_n as three impartial by relabeling. Conditional winner sets higher-ranked under each ballot are independent uniform subsets; pairwise disjointness yields exact Q_n triple sum. Binomial mixture gives polynomial, May/Sauermann Q_n~(pi^1.5/2)n^-1/2 supplies n^-1/4 balance. Exhaustive exact profile enumeration independent for n=3,4, all mixture eps in {0,1/4,1/2,1}.
